PM Modi to flag off India's first hydrogen train in Jind

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Jind, Haryana, on July 17 to flag off India's first hydrogen train. The train will operate commercially between Jind and Sonipat, covering approximately 356 km daily with two 89 km round trips. The train has a capacity of 2,600 passengers and 682 seats. Preparations for the Prime Minister's visit are underway, with Jind being decorated for the occasion. This initiative is part of India's efforts to reduce fossil fuel dependence.
